results.title: General Manager – Logistics Stockyard (Automotive)
results.description: The Job Summary The General Manager leads Petromin Logistics' stockyard as a profitable, customer-focused and technology-driven automotive logistics business. The role owns the full P&L, acquires and retains vehicle-brand accounts, and delivers reliable service across the vehicle lifecycle, driving the stockyard's launch and growth through digital operations, financial discipline and continuous improvement. Key Performance Indicators / Measures: • Revenue, operating profit and cash flow vs. the approved business plan • Customer margin, cost per vehicle and capacity utilisation • New vehicle-brand accounts won and growth of existing accounts • Customer satisfaction, retention and SLA achievement • Vehicle turnaround, dispatch reliability and PDI first-time-right • Damage, rework and claims recovery • Digital and AI use cases delivered, with measured gains in productivity, accuracy and cost • Safety, quality and business-continuity performance; team capability The KPIs listed in this JD define what the role is measured on; specific targets and weights are set and may be adjusted annually through the performance management cycle, in agreement with the line manager. Technical / Job-Specific Competencies 1 Business Plan & P&L Ownership Own the stockyard business plan, budget and P&L, and drive pricing, cost control, billing and collections, to deliver revenue, profit and cash targets. 2 Profitability & Investment Manage profitability by customer and service, cost per vehicle and break-even utilisation, and build investment cases for capacity and technology, to secure measurable returns. 3 Strategic Account Acquisition Personally lead account acquisition with Business Development, winning OEM, vehicle-brand, importer and distributor business through strong relationships and competitive proposals, to grow and diversify revenue. 4 Contracts & Account Growth Negotiate contracts and service levels with Finance and Legal, and grow existing accounts in line with operational capacity, to secure profitable, sustainable business. 5 Digital Strategy & Systems Lead the stockyard's digital strategy, integrating YMS, ERP, transport and customer systems, to give real-time vehicle visibility, accurate inventory and digital workflows. 6 AI & Automation Adoption Prioritise and implement AI and automation for capacity planning, vehicle allocation, damage detection, predictive maintenance and reporting, with Corporate IT ensuring data quality, security and responsible AI use, to lower cost and raise productivity. 7 Stockyard Launch & Operations Lead readiness, launch and daily operations across receipt, storage, stock preservation, PDI, VAS, customs coordination and dispatch, and control outsourced service performance, to run a reliable, efficient stockyard. 8 Customer Experience & SLAs Deliver customer SLAs, resolve escalations and improve turnaround, productivity and vehicle condition through standard procedures and root-cause problem-solving, to raise satisfaction and retention. 9 People Leadership Develop accountable managers and digitally capable teams, and align workforce capacity and shared-service levels with business needs, to deliver the business plan. 10 Safety, Quality & Governance Own safety, quality, vehicle custody and business continuity, oversee damage prevention and claims recovery, and strengthen the Integrated Management System, reporting performance and risks to the CEO, to protect people, vehicles and the business. The Job Profile 1 Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or a related discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. 2 Professional Certifications No mandatory certification. A logistics or supply chain certification (e.g., ASCM CLTD / CSCP, CILT) is an advantage. 3 Experience 15+ years of relevant experience, including 5 years in senior leadership with direct P&L accountability; Saudi or GCC experience is preferred. 4 Essential Job Pre-Requisites Strong finished-vehicle logistics experience (stockyard operations, PDI, transportation, outsourced services), including launching or substantially improving a stockyard or comparable operation. Proven personal success winning and retaining OEM, importer, distributor or major logistics accounts. Demonstrated delivery of YMS, WMS, TMS or ERP integration or comparable digital transformation, with measurable results. 5 Languages Proficiency Fluency in English and Arabic is mandatory.

results.title: Fleet Operations Manager
results.location: Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia
results.description: JOB PURPOSE: The Fleet Operations Manager leads the group's land transport fleet and logistics execution, ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective movement of raw materials and finished products. The role manages fleet planning, maintenance, drivers, and third-party transporters, and leads the inbound and outbound logistics teams. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: Fleet Strategy & Planning Plan fleet capacity and utilization to meet inbound and outbound transport demand. Define fleet policies, standards, and KPIs in line with Supply Chain strategy. Develop and manage the fleet operating and capital budget. Fleet Operations & Maintenance Oversee daily fleet dispatch, routing, and delivery performance. Ensure vehicles are properly maintained, inspected, and compliant with licensing requirements. Control fuel, maintenance, and transport costs and drive efficiency improvements. Third-Party Transport Governance Manage contracts and performance of third-party transport and logistics providers. Evaluate transporter rates, service quality, and compliance on a regular basis. Resolve delivery issues, claims, and service failures with transporters. HSE & Team Leadership Enforce road safety, driver fitness, and HSE standards across the fleet. Lead and develop Land Logistics specialists and drivers. Report fleet performance, costs, and risks to VP Supply Chain. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE: Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. 6–11 years of experience in fleet management or land logistics, including team leadership. SAP, fleet management and tracking systems, and MS Office.

results.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Shipping & Logistics
results.description: The Chief Operating Officer (COO) will be a key member of the executive leadership team and will have overall responsibility for driving operational performance, service excellence, productivity, efficiency and sustainable growth across the logistics operations. The COO will provide strategic and operational leadership across the company's integrated logistics platform, covering Freight Forwarding – Sea, Air and Land, Procurement, Customs Clearance, Yard Management, Land Transportation and Fleet, Service Centers, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI), Warehousing and Contract Logistics. Working closely with the CEO and other members of the leadership team, the COO will translate the company's strategy into effective operating plans, establish consistent operating standards, strengthen cross-functional integration and ensure that the organization is positioned for scalable and profitable growth. The role carries significant responsibility for operational and financial performance, with partial P&L accountability, while maintaining a strong focus on customer retention, operational excellence, digital transformation, business expansion and organizational capability. The successful candidate will be expected to build a high-performance operating culture, improve utilization of people and assets, enhance customer experience, strengthen governance and controls, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the company's competitive position. Key Responsibilities: Overall Operations Leadership: Lead and oversee all UAE operational activities across Sea, Air and Land Freight Forwarding, Procurement, Customs Clearance, Yard Management, Land Transportation & Fleet, Service Centers, PDI, Warehousing and Contract Logistics. Operational Strategy: Develop and execute the UAE operations strategy in alignment with the company's overall business objectives and growth plans. Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement, standardization, productivity, efficiency and cost optimization across all operational functions. Integrated Operations: Ensure seamless coordination and integration between freight forwarding, customs, transportation, fleet, yards, warehouses, PDI and contract logistics to deliver end-to-end logistics solutions. Financial Performance: Take partial P&L responsibility for operations, with accountability for operating costs, productivity, margins, budgets and efficient utilization of resources and assets. Customer Retention & Service Excellence: Drive operational service quality and customer retention by ensuring consistent service delivery, timely resolution of operational issues and strong performance against customer commitments. Business Transformation: Lead operational transformation initiatives, including process re-engineering, automation, digitalization and data-driven performance management. Growth & Expansion: Support the CEO in identifying and implementing opportunities for business expansion, new services, capacity development, strategic partnerships and operational investments. Fleet & Asset Optimization: Maximize utilization and productivity of fleet, equipment, facilities, yards, warehouses and other operational assets while maintaining appropriate maintenance and safety standards. Procurement & Supplier Management: Provide strategic oversight of operational procurement and supplier performance, ensuring competitive sourcing, cost efficiency, service quality and strong supplier governance. Performance Management: Establish and monitor operational KPIs, dashboards and performance-management routines, ensuring clear accountability and timely corrective action across all operational departments. Risk, Compliance & HSE: Ensure operations comply with applicable UAE regulations, customer requirements and company policies, with strong focus on safety, security, risk management and business continuity. People & Leadership: Lead, coach and develop the operational leadership team, building a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, customer service and continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with the CEO, Finance, Commercial, HR, IT and other functions to ensure effective execution of the company's strategic and operational priorities. Executive Reporting: Provide the CEO and executive leadership team with regular reporting and insights on operational performance, financial results, customer issues, risks, opportunities and strategic initiatives. Key Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Maritime Studies, Operations Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 15 to 25 Years Experience in Supply Chain Management. Executive leadership certifications and professional memberships are advantageous. Experience managing large-scale, multi-site, or multi-country operations is highly desirable. GCC/UAE experience preferred. Personal Attributes: Visionary and entrepreneurial leader. Results-oriented with a strong commercial mindset. Highly proactive and resilient. Strong executive presence and communication skills. Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities. Able to lead through change and drive business transformation. High integrity, professionalism, and accountability.

results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Logistics Manager
results.description: FITT Meals is a UAE-based healthy meal plan and food production business with a team of over 150 employees. Operating from our state-of-the-art 40,000-square-foot facility in Dubai Industrial City, we serve direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) customers across the UAE, completing tens of thousands of deliveries every month. About the Role We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Logistics Manager to lead our outbound logistics and delivery operations across all seven emirates. You'll take ownership of customer orders once packaged and handed over by Production, overseeing dispatch, route planning, fleet management and final delivery to our D2C and B2B customers. You'll lead our team of drivers and supervisors, ensuring deliveries are completed safely, accurately, on time and cost-effectively. We're looking for someone who will challenge existing processes, bring fresh ideas and drive continuous improvement, balancing customer experience with food safety, team wellbeing and commercial performance. Key Responsibilities Delivery Operations & Dispatch Oversee D2C and B2B deliveries across all seven emirates. Manage the receipt, verification, allocation and dispatch of packaged customer orders. Coordinate drivers, schedules, routes and vehicles, resolving operational challenges and delivery issues. Work closely with Production, Customer Service and Commercial teams to ensure smooth operations. Maintain effective delivery procedures, escalation processes and contingency plans. Fleet & Route Management Optimise delivery routes, driver productivity and vehicle utilisation. Manage fleet servicing, maintenance, registrations, insurance and compliance. Monitor fleet costs, fuel consumption and performance, identifying opportunities for improvement. Manage logistics suppliers and evaluate vehicle purchasing, rental and replacement requirements. Team Leadership & Capacity Planning Lead, develop and manage drivers and dispatch supervisors, building a culture of accountability and teamwork. Oversee workforce scheduling, attendance, training and operational coverage. Plan workforce, fleet and delivery capacity to accommodate customer growth, seasonal demand and new business opportunities. Commercial Performance & Continuous Improvement Manage logistics budgets, operating costs and performance against agreed KPIs. Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, customer experience and cost per delivery. Use operational data, technology and customer feedback to drive measurable improvements. Challenge existing processes and implement more efficient systems and ways of working. Support B2B and event logistics, assessing operational requirements, capacity and costs. About You Minimum 5 years' experience in logistics and distribution operations, including at least 3 years in a management role. Extensive experience managing logistics and delivery operations in the UAE is essential. Experience in food distribution, FMCG, meal delivery or temperature-controlled logistics is highly desirable. Proven experience managing high-volume deliveries, drivers, dispatch teams and vehicle fleets. Strong commercial awareness, with experience managing budgets, operational costs and KPIs. Confident using logistics systems, route optimisation tools and performance data. A hands-on, proactive leader with excellent problem-solving, communication and people management skills. Customer-focused, commercially minded and confident challenging existing processes to deliver improvements. Join FITT Meals This is an opportunity to take ownership of a high-volume logistics operation within a growing UAE business. We're looking for someone who doesn't just manage the operation as it is today, but has the ambition, experience and ideas to make it better for tomorrow. Location: Dubai Industrial City, Dubai, UAE If you have the experience and drive to lead our logistics operation, we'd love to hear from you.

results.title: Logistics & Mobility Director
results.description: MARAFID is the execution arm of Riyadh Holding Company, specializing in the development and activation of economic infrastructure across three core sectors: Logistics & Mobility, Industrial Clusters, and Circular Economy. We bring together development, asset management, leasing, and strategic partnerships to translate these sectors into projects and services that support business activity and serve the needs of operators, tenants, and investors. Our focus spans logistics parks, truck stations, parking facilities, specialized industrial hubs, and infrastructure for material aggregation, reuse, and recycling. Digital solutions and shared services support the management of these assets and their connections with the businesses they serve. Through collaboration with public and private sector partners, MARAFID connects land, infrastructure, and operational expertise to support Riyadh’s economic growth. We are currently seeking a Logistics & Mobility Director to manage and coordinate MARAFID’s logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, overseeing sector assets, services, and ecosystem participants to ensure effective service delivery, operational performance, and sustainable growth of the sector. 1. Key Responsibilities Oversee logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, coordinating activities across MARAFID’s relevant assets, facilities, services, and sector initiatives. Manage the operational performance of sector assets and services, monitoring utilization, service levels, revenues, costs, and other key operational indicators. Coordinate with operators, tenants, service providers, and ecosystem partners to ensure effective integration and delivery of services across the logistics and mobility ecosystem. Identify and implement operational improvement opportunities to enhance asset utilization, service quality, efficiency, customer experience, and overall ecosystem performance. Support the launch and operationalization of new logistics and mobility offerings, ensuring the effective transition of new projects and services into ongoing operations. Monitor sector demand, customer needs, and operational trends to identify opportunities to enhance existing services and inform future ecosystem development. Coordinate with relevant corporate functions to support effective and compliant operations. 2. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of relevant experience in logistics, mobility, operations, asset management, service delivery, or a related field. Strong understanding of operational performance, service delivery, asset utilization, and key operational indicators. Strong stakeholder management, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Fluency in Arabic and English.

results.title: Head of Freight Forwarding, Shipping & Customs
results.description: Own and grow FLOW's freight forwarding and shipping business across sea, air and multimodal trade lanes—leading commercial performance, carrier and agency relationships, and operational execution to deliver profitable, reliable freight services. results.title: Global Senior Manager– Healthcare Freight Forwarding
results.description: Job Description The role sets the global product framework and ensures that healthcare-specific regulatory, quality and operational requirements are translated into scalable freight forwarding processes, qualified network capabilities, service standards, systems and performance measures. Working across Global Air Freight, Temperature Controlled Logistics, regions, countries, Quality Management and Commercial teams, the role governs the implementation of Good Distribution Practice (GDP) standards, directs the development of qualified healthcare transport solutions and drives consistent service quality across the global freight forwarding network. The position is accountable for the global Healthcare Freight product roadmap, capability priorities and performance improvement agenda, enabling compliant growth, differentiated customer solutions and a reliable, scalable global healthcare logistics offering. Key Accountabilities Healthcare Freight Product Development Own the development and continuous improvement of DP World's global Healthcare Freight Forwarding product, with Air Freight as the primary focus. Translate healthcare customer requirements and regulatory standards into practical freight forwarding solutions, operating procedures and service specifications. Work with Global Air Freight, Temperature Controlled Logistics and regional teams to strengthen healthcare-specific freight capabilities and service consistency. Support the development of integrated and multimodal healthcare freight solutions where required, ensuring appropriate coordination with other transport products. Define and govern the global Healthcare Freight product roadmap, prioritising investments and initiatives that improve service quality, network capability, commercial differentiation and customer value. GDP Compliance and Quality Standards Set the global framework for implementing Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements across the healthcare freight forwarding network, with particular emphasis on Air Freight operations. Translate relevant regulatory frameworks, including EU GDP, WHO GDP and applicable customer requirements, into operational standards, procedures and supporting documentation. Develop, maintain and continuously improve global Healthcare Freight SOPs, with specific requirements for temperature-controlled Air Freight handling and transportation. Work with Quality Management, regional and country teams to identify compliance gaps, monitor corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and promote continuous improvement. Support the implementation of consistent healthcare quality standards across stations, gateways, hubs and approved service providers. Healthcare Network Development and Qualification Lead the development and governance of a globally consistent healthcare freight network, prioritising GDP-qualified Air Freight stations, gateways, hubs and transport partners. Establish healthcare-specific operational qualification criteria in collaboration with Global Air Freight, Quality Management and regional operations. Assess network readiness, service capabilities and operational risks to support the expansion of healthcare freight services. Coordinate with relevant product teams to ensure appropriate healthcare handling standards across multimodal transport solutions where applicable.Identify network capability gaps and recommend improvements to support customer requirements and business growth. Carrier and Service Provider Quality Management Develop and maintain healthcare-specific qualification and performance standards for airlines, ground handling agents, trucking providers, packaging suppliers, monitoring solution providers and other relevant subcontractors. Support the assessment and qualification of service providers against applicable healthcare, GDP and temperature-control requirements. Work with Procurement, Global Air Freight and Operations to monitor supplier performance and address service quality issues. Support supplier performance reviews, quality assessments and corrective action plans. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the global healthcare freight partner network. Customer Engagement and Quality Agreements Support Commercial and Key Account Management teams in healthcare customer engagements, including business reviews, workshops, audits and technical discussions. Provide specialist input into customer contracts, Master Services Agreements and Quality Agreements, particularly regarding healthcare handling, temperature control and operational compliance. Support the alignment of customer-specific requirements with DP World's freight forwarding capabilities and operating standards. Work with relevant stakeholders to identify and address potential service or compliance gaps. Contribute to the development of commercially competitive and operationally sustainable healthcare freight solutions. Operational Risk Management and Service Quality Coordinate healthcare transport lane risk assessments, with particular emphasis on temperature-controlled Air Freight movements. Support the use and continuous improvement of approved risk assessment platforms, including Validaide. Define and maintain healthcare-specific handling and risk mitigation requirements, including temperature excursions, high-value shipments and time-critical cargo. Support investigations into healthcare service failures, temperature deviations, customer complaints and audit findings. Coordinate with Operations, Quality Management and service providers to identify root causes and monitor corrective and preventive actions. Promote consistent risk management and quality assurance practices across the freight forwarding network. Temperature-Controlled Transport Solutions Support the definition and maintenance of approved temperature-controlled transport solutions for healthcare freight, with a strong focus on Air Freight. Evaluate active containers, passive packaging solutions, temperature-monitoring devices and other specialised healthcare transport equipment. Work with suppliers, operations and quality teams to assess solution suitability, performance and compliance with customer requirements. Contribute to the standardisation of temperature-controlled handling and transport practices. Identify opportunities to improve shipment integrity, service reliability and operational efficiency. Support the development of temperature-monitoring capabilities, shipment milestones, audit trails, excursion reporting and customer-specific compliance requirements.
